items.title: 52035_Eddie Durham oral history interview
items.q: Henry says, 'We got the greatest arrangement' he has ever heard in his life on 'Sweet Georgia Brown.' ... Henry came out there and he played 'Misty' on his soprano.

ctx.x: : Oh, that's -- I tell him you should do with (inaudible), stop fooling around with those saxaphones, you know.
